_readme: Structured-condition replacement for milestones_v1.json (RTI Legacy System Pass 3). Every entry is {label, condition}; condition is evaluated by evaluateChallengeCondition in challenges.ts against a whitelisted stat set (see SUPPORTED_CHALLENGE_STATS). Entries carrying a '_note' documents a deliberate change from the original v1 string during translation -- either a TFL removal (tackles_for_loss is never populated by any live import) or a genuine parser-bug fix found while translating (a clause the old regex parser silently mishandled). No numeric threshold was re-tuned in this pass beyond what a '_note' calls out; real completion-rate calibration is Pass 4's job.
